tesattati.l: Saṁyuttake āgatāni tesattati ñāṇāni sattasattati ñāṇānī
tesattati.g: vuttaṁ2, tattha pana nidānavagge3 sattasattati āgatāni catucattārīsañca, tesattati pana paṭisambhidāmagge4 sutamayādīni āgatāni dissanti, na saṁyuttake.
vuttaṁ, tattha3 pana nidānavagge sattasattati āgatāni catucattārīsañca.

tesattati.l: Saṁyuttake āgatāni tesattati ñāṇāni, sattasattati ñāṇānī
tesattati.g: vuttaṁ, tattha pana nidānavagge sattasattati āgatāni catucattārīsañca, tesattati pana paṭisambhidāmagge sutamayādīni āgatāni dissanti, na saṁyuttaketi.
sāvakehi sādhāraṇāsādhāraṇavasena uddiṭṭhāni imāni tesattati ñāṇāni.

tesaṭṭhiyā.g: jambudīpe kira ādito mahantāni tesaṭṭhi nagarasahassāni uppannāni, tathā dutiyaṁ, tathā tatiyaṁ.

Tesattatīnaṁ.g: paṭisambhidāpāḷiyaṁ1 “sotāvadhāne paññā sutamaye ñāṇaṁ, sutvāna saṁvare paññā sīlamaye ñāṇan”ti-ādinā ñāṇakathāya niddiṭṭhānaṁ sāvakasādhāraṇāsādhāraṇānaṁ ñāṇānaṁ.
